$comment: Global provider/model routing. MODEL_<ROLE> overrides models.json. Splice defaults use Qwen via Bedrock Converse; Claude overrides use the Anthropic Messages API. Non-Claude models require splice_compatible in options. Python roles are unchanged.

role_notes.decomp_worker: Python OpenCode/Ghidra worker (launch.py). Any OpenCode-supported model.
role_notes.electron_reconstructor: Fallback OpenCode role for both Electron reconstruction stages. Stage roles below win. Override with MODEL_ELECTRON_RECONSTRUCTOR.
role_notes.electron_spec_writer: Stage 1: observes a packaged Electron app through the oracle and writes the public behavioral specification. Override with MODEL_ELECTRON_SPEC_WRITER.
role_notes.electron_implementer: Stage 2: implements the app from the public specification alone, with no oracle or archive access. Override with MODEL_ELECTRON_IMPLEMENTER.
role_notes.spec_writer: Splice spec_writer: Qwen3 Coder 480B via Bedrock Converse. Environment overrides remain supported.
role_notes.engine_writer: Splice engine_writer: Qwen3 Coder 480B via Bedrock Converse. Environment overrides remain supported.
role_notes.ui_synthesizer: Splice ui_synthesizer: Qwen3 Coder 480B via Bedrock Converse. Environment overrides remain supported.
role_notes.refusal_fallback: Splice refusal_fallback: Qwen3 Coder 480B via Bedrock Converse. Environment overrides remain supported. Retry once on a distinct configured model; identical-model retries are skipped.

options.label: Qwen3 Coder 480B (A35B)
options.note: Coding model. Splice's implementor agent (engine_writer) through llm.ts's Bedrock Converse path; also usable by OpenCode roles. Verified in us-east-2 with the bare ID (the us. inference profile is rejected).
